name: Sephara, Sky's Blade
oracle_text:
You may pay {W} and tap four untapped creatures you control with flying rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Flying, lifelink
Other creatures you control with flying have indestructible. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy them.)
blocked_sentences: You may pay {W} and tap four untapped creatures you control with flying rather than pay this spell's mana cost.

needs.what: a residual-gate claimant in `verify._covered` for a card-level `alternative_cost` printed line ("... rather than pay this spell's mana cost" / "... you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost") on a PERMANENT. The mechanic itself already loads and works: `alternative_cost: {"mana": "{W}", "tap_permanents": {"types": ["Creature"], "keywords": ["flying"], "count": 4}}` compiles cleanly via `compile_card`, and the static `grant_keyword` indestructible line and the flying/lifelink keywords are expressible. Only the bookkeeping is missing: a claimant like evoke's/bestow's, gated on `card.alternative_cost is not None` and the sentence containing "rather than pay this spell's mana cost" or "without paying its mana cost" (ideally strict: the printed mana symbols matching `alternative_cost.mana`).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `verify._covered` has claimants for kicker, multikicker, strive, emerge, evoke, bestow, mutate, warp, additional_cost, cost_reduction, but none for `alternative_cost`. Every shipped `alternative_cost` card (Daze, Force of Will, Snuff Out, Flare of Denial, Fierce Guardianship, Flawless Maneuver, Submerge) is an instant whose line is blanket-claimed by `spell_effects`, so a creature carrying one has never been hit. No ability can honestly carry the line: a cost is not activated, triggered or static, and inventing an effectless static with that `text` would be a fake claim. `--collect` rejected the answer with `residual -- printed text not represented`.
